title: Item:Cookie Jar
wikitext:
__NOTOC__
[[File:Large Cookie Jar shown.png|thumb|150px|right|Cookie Jar with cookies.]]
'''Cookie Jars''' allow you to hold many of the same type of cookies and cakes without cluttering up your inventory space.

The game provides '''41 types of [[Potion#Festival cookies|Cookies and Cakes]]''' which can be acquired during [[Festivult]] or the [[Snowpeaks Festival]] and '''5 types of [[Item:Kookies|Kookies]]''' from the [[Anniversary Party|Anniversary Event]]. It is recommended to turn all coins in on one character (possibly a [[mule]] designated for event items only) to prevent a major inventory mess. A cookie jar can hold all Cookies and Cakes (at least until the max stack size is reached for a particular cookie type) in one inventory slot. The cookie jars are [[DDO Store]] items.

Cookie Jars are {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}. Note that Cookie Jars can grow quite heavy eventually, so it may not be a good idea to choose characters with a limited [[Carrying Capacity]] to carry this BtC item. Make sure you are on the right character before making the purchase.
<!--* Note: The "Lolth, The Spider Queen cookie" is obtained from the [[Midwinter Festival]] as a turn-in reward for Motes of Winter rather than the Jester coin turn in. It still goes into the Cookie Jar.-->
